        """mag.csv equals STFT (Hann, hop=256, n_fft=1024, center=False) using scipy."""

        mag_csv = _load_mag_csv_array()
    
        # Compute STFT using scipy
        from scipy.signal import stft as sp_stft
    
        f, t, Zxx = sp_stft(

            fs=sr,
            window="hann",
            nperseg=1024,
            noverlap=1024 - 256,
            nfft=1024,
            boundary=None,
            padded=False,
            return_onesided=True,
        )
